control.title: Cardholder data environment scope and segmentation
control.description: Document every system, network and process that stores, processes or transmits cardholder data or can affect its security, keep a data-flow diagram, segment the cardholder data environment and confirm the scope at least every 12 months.

implementation_notes: Implemented at Paisa Setu Fintech and reviewed annually.
evidence_hint: Scope document, cardholder data-flow diagram, segmentation test results.
